Game Overview

Fatty Ken is a monster title where join Fatty Ken on a high-energy 2D platform adventure, dodging enemies and traps while collecting dumbbells. Master the double-jump to navigate obstacles and beat increasingly challenging levels. Can you reach the finish flag and push through all eight levels of excitement and peril?

How to Play

Fatty Ken keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Join Fatty Ken on a high-energy 2D platform adventure, dodging enemies and traps while collecting dumbbells.
